title: SECV_Tlajomulco: code and derived data for "Los límites de la mirada. Archivo fotogramétrico y transformación socioambiental"
description: Code and derived data for the book chapter "Los límites de la mirada" (Montes Ruiz and Bermeo Donoso), Seminario Permanente de Estudios de Cultura Visual, CEIICH-UNAM. Coverage analysis of INEGI aerial survey metadata (SIIV) and cartographic regression of 1971 and 1993 aerial photographs of Tlajomulco de Zúñiga, Jalisco, Mexico. INEGI images are not included.
